insert into safety_park_power_rule_history(POST_NAME,ORG_CODE,FACTORY_POWER,PRIORITY,REMARK,TARGET_ID,CREATE_TIME,UPDATE_TIME) values
(#{item.postName}, #{item.orgCode}, #{item.factoryPower}, #{item.priority}, #{item.remark}, #{item.targetId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE POST_NAME = VALUES(POST_NAME), ORG_CODE = VALUES(ORG_CODE), FACTORY_POWER = VALUES(FACTORY_POWER), PRIORITY = VALUES(PRIORITY), REMARK = VALUES(REMARK), UPDATE_TIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: select n.id,n.is_delete, n.post_name, n.ORG_CODE, n.FACTORY_POWER,n.PRIORITY, h.post_name his_post_name,h.ORG_CODE HIS_ORG_CODE,h.FACTORY_POWER HIS_FACTORY_POWER from safety_park_power_rule n left join safety_park_power_rule_history h on n.id = h.target_id where (n.update_time > date_format(concat(date_sub(curdate(),interval 1 day),' 23:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') or H.UPDATE_TIME is null)
